$comment: Named, time-limited exceptions for DEVELOPMENT-ONLY dependency advisories.
This file is NOT a suppression list for the production audit gate. The
production gate lives in tests/security/dependencies.test.ts, runs
`pnpm audit --json --prod`, fails on any high or critical finding, and does
not read this file. The two mechanisms are deliberately separate.
1. every entry must carry all required fields;
2. every entry must have a future review/expiry date — an expired entry
fails the suite, which forces a decision instead of silent drift;
3. an advisory is only excused if `pnpm audit` reports every one of its
findings as dev-only. A production finding is never excused here;
4. any dev-only advisory that is NOT listed here fails the suite, so a
newly introduced advisory cannot arrive unnoticed.

exceptions.title: brace-expansion regular expression denial of service
exceptions.justification: PARTIALLY REMEDIATED. The advisory marks every release up to 5.0.7 vulnerable and only 5.0.8 patched, so no in-major patch exists for the 1.x line. A pnpm override pins the 5.x line (reached via minimatch@10) to ^5.0.8. An unscoped `brace-expansion: ^5.0.8` override was attempted and tested: it breaks eslint outright (`TypeError: expand is not a function` in minimatch@3.1.5) because brace-expansion 5.x replaced the callable default export with a named `{ expand }` export, so minimatch@3 consumers cannot take it. The Vitest/Vite migration cleared the former @vitest/coverage-v8 glob/minimatch chain; the only remaining vulnerable path is eslint 9 / @eslint tooling through minimatch ^3.1.5. This is lint tooling that only expands glob patterns authored inside this repository — a ReDoS needs an attacker-supplied pattern, and there is none.
exceptions.scope: devDependency only — eslint tooling chain; brace-expansion is absent from every production dependency tree.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when eslint's minimatch@3 chain resolves brace-expansion >=5.0.8 (expected to require eslint 10 / @eslint/config-array >=0.23.x and @eslint/eslintrc on minimatch 10). Verify with `pnpm why brace-expansion`, then delete this entry and the `brace-expansion@5` override in pnpm-workspace.yaml if it is no longer needed.
